Built for getting paid the right amount

Three things shop owners, freelancers and creators ask for — in one small app.

Same amount, every time

Enter the amount once and Antify Pay locks it into the QR. Your customer can’t change it, so what you ask for is what you receive.

  • Amount in ₹ with one-tap presets
  • Optional payment note or purpose
  • Optional merchant or business name

Share, save, copy, get paid

Download the QR as an image, share it on WhatsApp, or copy the UPI link. Use Test Pay to check it opens in your payment app before you send it.

  • Download QR code as an image
  • Share or copy in one tap
  • Test Pay before you send

All your UPI IDs in one place

Save every UPI profile you use and switch between them in a tap. Your history keeps a record of the QR codes you have made.

  • Saved UPI profiles
  • History of generated QR codes
  • Delete a profile any time

Take a look inside

Clean screens, big buttons, nothing you don’t need.

Ready in three steps

  1. 1

    Add your UPI ID

    Type it in and tap Save UPI. Add a business name if you want customers to see one.

  2. 2

    Set the amount

    Pick a preset or enter any amount, then add a note about what the payment is for.

  3. 3

    Generate and share

    Tap Generate QR, then download, share or copy it. Your customer scans and pays.

Get Antify Pay on your phone

Download the APK, open it on your Android phone and allow installs from your browser or file manager when asked.
